Fix the position of 1 on the circle (arrangements that differ only by rotation are treated as the same). Going around from 1 in either direction, the numbers must increase, so each arc from 1 is an increasing run that ends at 7, the largest number. Each of the numbers 2 through 6 must lie on one of the two arcs, and its position on that arc is then forced by the increasing order. So each of the 5 numbers 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 has 2 choices, giving 2^5 = 32 arrangements.

ANSWER: 32
